payload.title: Support immutable per-command environment overrides
payload.summary: Complete the maintained command execution roadmap obligation for per-command environment overrides. Add optional environment: Mapping[str, str] | None to the existing immutable public Command specification. None (the default) and an empty mapping inherit the current parent environment at process launch; a nonempty mapping overlays only its keys, including empty-string and Unicode values. Never modify os.environ, including concurrent command execution. Snapshot caller mappings defensively, expose a read-only mapping, preserve frozen/value/hash semantics with order-independent equality/hash for equivalent overrides, and preserve the environment through every existing fluent operation. Provide with_environment(mapping) to replace overrides and without_environment() to restore inheritance. Reject non-mappings/non-string keys or values with TypeError and empty names, equals signs in names, or NUL in names/values with ValueError at construction and fluent replacement. Preserve argv, cwd, timeout, output/events/result identity and all existing command behavior. This is not a shell or permission grant. Investigate the existing implementation and related resources before coordinated edits. Behavioral acceptance, existing regressions, Ruff, formatting and strict typing are all mandatory; do not change tests or acceptance.
payload.benefit: Existing managed commands can configure child-specific execution without global environment mutation or shell workarounds.
payload.uncertainty: Named roadmap obligation, not a new authority system. Local task acceptance does not grant protected publication. No environment deletion API or process-group work is included.
dependencies: Existing immutable Command, fluent replace semantics and managed child lifecycle
